description: This file defines event tracing functions for the trace2 system within a Git-like project. It includes mechanisms to record diverse events such as start, exit, error, signals, command execution, region nesting, data, performance timers, and counters, mainly producing JSON formatted output for external tracing tools or logs.

classes.name: tr2_dst
classes.description: Structure representing the destination for trace events, configured for JSON output in this context.

classes.name: json_writer
classes.description: Helper structure used to build JSON objects for trace events.

classes.name: tr2_tgt
classes.description: Structure holding function pointers for different trace event types, here implemented for the 'event' target.

methods.name: int fn_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the event trace system, configuring nesting levels and brief mode based on environment variables.

methods.name: void fn_term(void)
methods.description: Terminates and disables the event trace system.

methods.name: void event_fmt_prepare(const char * event_name,const char * file,int line,const struct repository * repo,struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Prepares common JSON key-value pairs for an event, including event name, session ID, thread, time, file, line, and repository info.

methods.name: fn_version
methods.description: Logs a version event indicating the JSON format version and git version.

methods.name: fn_start
methods.description: Logs a 'start' event with elapsed time and arguments.

methods.name: fn_exit
methods.description: Logs an 'exit' event with elapsed time and exit code.

methods.name: void fn_signal(uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,int signo)
methods.description: Logs a 'signal' event with timestamp and signal number.

methods.name: void fn_atexit(uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,int code)
methods.description: Logs an 'atexit' event with timestamp and exit code.

methods.name: fn_error_va
methods.description: Logs an 'error' event with an optional formatted message.

methods.name: fn_command_path
methods.description: Logs a 'cmd_path' event with the command pathname.

methods.name: fn_command_ancestry
methods.description: Logs a 'cmd_ancestry' event with a list of parent command names.

methods.name: fn_command_name
methods.description: Logs a 'cmd_name' event with command name and optional hierarchy.

methods.name: fn_command_mode
methods.description: Logs a 'cmd_mode' event with command mode.

methods.name: fn_alias
methods.description: Logs an 'alias' event for a command alias and its arguments.

methods.name: fn_child_start
methods.description: Logs a 'child_start' event with child process info.

methods.name: fn_child_exit
methods.description: Logs a 'child_exit' event with process IDs, exit code, and timing.

methods.name: fn_child_ready
methods.description: Logs a 'child_ready' event indicating a child process is ready.

methods.name: fn_exec
methods.description: Logs an 'exec' event with execution ID, command, and arguments.

methods.name: fn_exec_result
methods.description: Logs an 'exec_result' event with execution ID and result code.

methods.name: fn_param
methods.description: Logs a 'def_param' event with scope, parameter, and value.

methods.name: fn_repo
methods.description: Logs a 'def_repo' event with repository info.

methods.name: fn_region_enter_printf_va
methods.description: Logs a 'region_enter' event with optional label and message.

methods.name: fn_region_leave_printf_va
methods.description: Logs a 'region_leave' event with timing and optional label/message.

methods.name: fn_data
methods.description: Logs a 'data' event with category, key, and value.

methods.name: fn_data_json
methods.description: Logs a 'data_json' event with category, key, and JSON value.

methods.name: fn_printf_va
methods.description: Logs a 'printf' event with a message.

methods.name: void fn_timer(const struct tr2_timer_metadata * meta,const struct tr2_timer * timer,int is_final_data)
methods.description: Logs performance timer metrics such as total, min, max durations.

methods.name: void fn_counter(const struct tr2_counter_metadata * meta,const struct tr2_counter * counter,int is_final_data)
